title: Lisp layer manifest line
description: One line of <layer root>/<model dir>/manifest.jsonl, the Lisp image's record of a model's layer of adaptable-function definitions (<layer root> is ~/.om/layer; <model dir> is layer.ModelDir of the model id). Each line is one generation: a definition held, settled or reverted on the evidence rule, forgotten, or the layer rolled back to an earlier generation. The definitions themselves (held/<name>.lisp, settled/<name>.lisp, blobs/<digest>.lisp) are Lisp source text, not JSON; held/index.json has the layer-held-index shape. Source: lisp/src/layer/store.lisp (append-generation, replay); a settled definition's revert is the retire rule's (lisp/src/rules/evidence.lisp).

gen.description: The generation number, from 1 and increasing in manifest order; the next is after the highest any line records, a line torn by a crash included, so no number is written twice.

digest.description: The digest of the definition's text (layer.Digest): 16 hex characters.

reason.description: Why the evidence rule settled or reverted it.

settled.description: On a revert: the retire rule reverted the settled definition of the name (when digest still stands), not a held one.
